content: Definition of Dem_GetDTCSelectionResultForClearDTC functionality The API Dem_GetDTCSelectionResultForClearDTC shall be- have exactly as Dem_GetDTCSelectionResult with the only difference that, DEM_WRONG_DTC is returned in case of a single DTC was selected and Dem- ClearDTCLimitation is set to DEM_ONLY_CLEAR_ALL_DTCS for that client.
